messages.subject: For C.C. Wei | Semiconductor expansion, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear TSMC Public Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Dr. C.C. Wei, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

TSMC's global expansion and strategic manufacturing investments operate at the intersection of governments, infrastructure, energy, communities and long-term technology partnerships. That stakeholder environment closely matches my current leadership responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and emerging-market stakeholder execution might support TSMC's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to TSMC.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
